It was **single-pass**: it validated and created each pool in the same loop, so an invalid spec later in the map could be hit only *after* earlier pools had already been created. Rewrote it as **two-pass**:
- **Pass 1** — iterate the entire `poolMap`, parse/validate every spec, collecting the pool objects. If any spec fails to parse, log and `return err` immediately, creating nothing.

- **Non-conflicting case**: it skipped when the condition was absent *or* had `ConditionFalse`. Now it skips **only when no conflict condition is present** (`cond == nil`), so a present-but-false condition still triggers removal + `UpdateStatus`.
